verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents official, typed SDKs across ten languages, including a first-party JavaScript/TypeScript client and a Python client with async support. Its versioning policy states that SDK versions are decoupled from engine releases. Community reports mention an alpha-stage .NET client at 1.0 and a Rails gem that drifted from the server, which signal uneven maturity across SDKs rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth per-SDK reference documentation in the evidence, independent corroboration of SDK quality and parity across all languages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Typed SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart, and .NET.
The official JavaScript client for Meilisearch, with full TypeScript support for Node.js and browser environments.
The official Python client for Meilisearch with async support and type hints.
First-party Meilisearch driver for Laravel Scout, the official Laravel search package.
